title: too big and too square
text: too big and too square. Not easy to use at all. Its too darn big for our nine foot tree and its completely square....yes, even the top. So the fit is really strange and sloppy. Just cant get it to stay in place because it so stiff and the excess doesnt fold.

product_metadata.title: Zober Upright Tree Storage Bag for Christmas Trees of 7.5ft. Tall, Tree Bag Is Tear Proof Polyethylene; Comes With Drawstring Hem, Zipper And Carry Handles, Waterproof Material Protects From Dust & Moisture
features: EFFORTLESS AND CONVENIENT - Specially engineered tree bag with a full-length zipper wraps the tree instead of the tree having to be inserted. Leave the tree upright and assembled when storing it in this bag.
DURABLE AND STURDY - Crafted of tough polyethylene, this tree bag won’t tear, fade, or disintegrate. Able to withstand years of use and abuse, it is likely to outlive your tree.

ADJUSTS TO TREE - Three buckle straps along the tree bag enable you to adjust it to the size of the tree; ensure your tree is secure, with no room to wiggle. An additional Velcro strap at the bottom of the bag maximizes the tight fit.
PROTECTED IN STORAGE - The custom-designed drawstring hem protects your tree’s delicate branches, while keeping out dust and grime. Waterproof.

HOLIDAY CHEER - Cheery Christmas holiday colors liven up the atmosphere and make packing up the Christmas holiday a pleasurable and joyful experience. Designed with lively hues, it lends a sophisticated yet exciting look to your holiday storage.
